chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Uthman ibn Isa, from a number of our companions who said:

When Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) passed away, Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) ordered that the lantern remain in the house where he had dwelled, until Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) passed away. Then Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him) ordered that similar be done in the house of Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), until he went out with it to Iraq. Then I do not know what happened.

key_terms.أَبُو الْحَسَنِ: Imam Musa al-Kadhim (peace be upon him)
key_terms.أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ: Imam Muhammad al-Baqir (peace be upon him)
key_terms.أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (peace be upon him)

ai.seo_question: What was the tradition regarding the lantern in the house of the Imams after their death?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Al-Kafi* documents the specific ritual of maintaining a lamp in the residence of the Imams following their death, a practice initiated by Imam al-Sadiq for Imam al-Baqir and continued by Imam al-Kadhim, symbolizing the enduring spiritual presence and honor of the Ahl al-Bayt. The narrative underscores the continuity of this tradition across generations, reflecting the Shia scholarly emphasis on the physical spaces associated with the Imams as sites of reverence and remembrance. The narrator's concluding uncertainty highlights the oral transmission nature of early hadith literature, where details of later events were sometimes preserved without precise chronological closure.

en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Usman Bin Isa, from a number of our companions who said,

‘When Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> passed away, Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> ordered (his<sup>asws</sup> people) with the lantern in the house where he<sup>asws</sup> had dwelled in until Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> passed away. Then Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> ordered with similar to that in the house of Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, until he<sup>asws</sup> went out with it to Al-Iraq. Then I do not know what happened’.
en.sarwar: 5. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from ‘Uthman ibn ‘Isa from a number of our people has narrated the following: “

When abu Ja‘far passed away abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, commanded (his people) to light a lamp in the house where he lived until abu ‘Abd Allah passed away. Thereafter abu al-Hassan did a similar thing in the house where abu ‘Abd Allah lived until he was taken to Iraq and thereafter I do not know what happened.”
